_why: A gate nobody runs is a gate that never fails. Every file here is either run by scripts/verify-release.sh (auto) or has a written reason it cannot be.

about-gate.mjs.why: needs a signed-in browser and a build that ships the about pane

auth-gate.mjs.why: runs against a local dev server; production auth is covered by auth-surface-gate

auth-surface-gate.mjs.why: manual: lockouts would block the automated runs that follow

auto-start-gate.mjs.why: needs a real gesture chain; flaky in headless

barge-in-gate.mjs.why: refuses https by design (mixed content); must run against http://127.0.0.1:3005

brand-assets-gate.mjs.why: runs inside the verifier: logo, icons, manifest and the white-surface count

brand-copy-gate.mjs.why: covered by brand-assets-gate inside the verifier

browser-gate.mjs.why: the browser service is a separate container and can go silent on its own

latency-gate.mjs.why: timing-sensitive; a loaded VPS makes it lie

panel-live-gate.mjs.why: spends a real Live session; run by hand before a release

session-longevity-gate.mjs.why: long-running; run before a release, not on every push

turn-counter-gate.mjs.why: spends a real Live session and waits for two full turns (~60 s)

ui-gate.mjs.why: broad UI sweep; slow, run before a release

vad-cutoff-gate.mjs.why: timing-sensitive measurement; abandoned as unreliable in headless

voice-gate.mjs.why: one real Live session per release; asserts mic frames, transcript, playback and mouth

windows-gate.mjs.why: the window layer is the thing most often broken; runs in ~30 s

text-panel-gate.mjs.why: the typed path has no tools; this is the only thing that proves a typed ask opens a window

tools-gate.mjs.catches: a tool context rebuilt per call, so browse cannot see the page she opened
tools-gate.mjs.runs: inside the gateway container (docker cp + docker exec)

proactive-gate.mjs.why: needs a real signed-in stage and the gateway clock; run by hand until it can be made deterministic

voice-hands-gate.mjs.why: opens a real Live session; the model has a per-key concurrent-session slot, so two runs inside a minute collide
voice-hands-gate.mjs.catches: the voice lane losing the ability to move her body or drive the page while every typed gate stays green

frame-gate.mjs.why: the window must redraw after her click, and a window must be placeable on either half
